texts.en:
Well done!

The first survey of a £system£ Star System beyond our own has been completed.

We now have access to planetary data that the astronomers on our homeworld could only dream of a mere generation ago.

To continue surveying;

£dot_green£ Select a £science_ship£ Science Ship
£dot_green£ Right-click a neighboring System
£dot_green£ Select Survey System

A System must be surveyed before it can be claimed.
